note: Rewritten from the original description by Froggatt (1898), where the species was placed in Eutermes as Eutermes triodiae; measurements are given in lines and not converted; plates and nest description omitted.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Alates with upper surface chestnut and fuscous wings, antennae 15-segmented, forewing submedian with 11–12 oblique veins; soldier head dark chestnut-brown with a short pointed nasus, antennae 14-segmented; worker head pale yellowish brown with two dark brown patches on the upper surface separated by a pale median suture.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head dark chestnut-brown, darkest on the sides and at the base of the nasus, tip of nasus reddish brown; antennae ochreous, paler at both ends of each segment; pronotum and abdominal tergites with yellowish brown markings, remainder pale yellow. Head nearly circular to the antennal base, nasus short and pointed, with a faint median suture; antennae 14-segmented, first segment stout and truncate, second shorter, third slender, fourth to thirteenth elongate-pyriform, terminal oval; palpi extending beyond the nasus; pronotum with ridge-like anterior margin, rounded sides and posterior margin; legs long and slender.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head pale yellowish brown, centre of upper surface dark brown, divided into two rounded patches by a pale yellow median suture that meets a transverse frontal suture and forms another band; clypeus very prominent, deeply divided into two rounded lobes; labrum narrow at the base and widening apically; mandibles stout with two apical teeth and a blunt tooth below; antennae 14-segmented, third and sixth segments longer.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head, thorax, scapular plates and abdominal tergites chestnut, remainder pale ochreous; wings fuscous with darker veins. Head rounded behind, width across eyes about equal to the distance from occiput to front of clypeus; frons sloping; eyes large, round, slightly projecting; ocelli large, irregularly oval, in line with the eye centres; antennae 15-segmented, first stout and cylindrical, third shortest, fourth to fourteenth broadly turbinate, terminal elongate-oval; clypeus large, deeply divided into two lobes; mandibles moderate with curved apical teeth; pronotum broad and saddle-shaped, anterior margin truncate, posterior margin broadly rounded; wings three times as long as broad, submedian with 11–12 oblique veins, the first six thickened. Length to wing tip about 5 lines.
